children: Alaunos Therapeutics shares surged after the company reported the acquisition of Velaris Therapeutics and a $350 million private placement led by Fairmount.
The stock recently more than doubled to $2.92 and is down about 9% this year.
Velaris is developing drugs for pulmonary arterial hypertension and related cardiopulmonary diseases.

Alaunos said other investors in the private placement included Venrock Healthcare Capital Partners, T. Rowe Price Investment Management, Wellington Management, Janus Henderson Investors and Access Biotechnology. The private placement is expected to fund operations into 2029.
Peter Harwin, founding partner of Fairmount, is joining the Alaunos board. Eventually, Fairmount designees are expected to constitute four of the company's five board members.
